name: Cyber Strike 2077
description: An open-world action RPG set in a dystopian future. Explore Night City, customize your character, and fight through gritty streets with cutting-edge cyberware.

name: Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree
description: A massive expansion to the critically acclaimed action RPG. New lands, bosses, and weapons await in this dark fantasy epic.

name: Valorant Champions Edition
description: Tactical 5v5 character-based shooter. Choose your agent, master your abilities, and lead your team to victory.

name: FIFA FC 25 Ultimate
description: The world's game returns with HyperMotionV technology, creating the most realistic football experience ever.

name: Horizon Forbidden West
description: Join Aloy as she journeys to the Forbidden West to uncover ancient mysteries and battle fierce machines in this stunning action RPG.

name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare III
description: The latest installment in the iconic FPS franchise. Features remastered maps, new multiplayer modes, and the gripping Zombies experience.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
description: Link returns to Hyrule in this masterpiece sequel. New abilities like Ultrahand and Fuse let you create and explore like never before.

name: NBA 2K25
description: The most authentic basketball simulation returns. Build your MyPlayer, dominate the court, and experience next-gen graphics.

name: Resident Evil 4 Remake
description: The beloved survival horror classic reborn with stunning RE Engine graphics. Survive the nightmare in rural Spain.

name: Starfield
description: Explore the vast cosmos in Bethesda's most ambitious RPG. Over 1,000 planets to discover, customize your ship, and forge your destiny among the stars.

name: Grand Theft Auto VI
description: Return to Vice City in the most anticipated game ever. A thrilling crime saga set in a vibrant, sun-soaked metropolis inspired by Miami.

name: Minecraft Dungeons Ultimate
description: A dungeon crawler set in the Minecraft universe. Fight through hordes of mobs alone or with friends in this action-packed adventure.
